name: htmlq
description: Like jq but for HTML - query HTML documents using CSS selectors with text extraction and pretty printing

htmlq.description: Command-line HTML processor that applies CSS selectors to extract data, manipulate DOM elements, and format output
htmlq.usage:
htmlq 'title' < index.html
htmlq --text 'p' < page.html
htmlq --attribute href 'a' < links.html
htmlq --pretty 'div.content' < doc.html
htmlq --remove-nodes 'script' 'body' < clean.html
curl -s https://example.com | htmlq 'h1, h2'
